Solution: 1 1/3=(1×3+1)/3=4/3. Keep the dividend and invert only the divisor: 4/3÷(2/3)=4/3×(3/2)=12/6=2. Check: (2)×(2/3)=4/3, the original dividend.

Solution: Write 12 as 12/1. Keep the dividend and invert only the divisor: 12÷(3/4)=12×(4/3)=48/3=16. Check: (16)×(3/4)=12, the original dividend.
